first.noKey: This browser doesn't have the key from the link. Open the full link you received again.
first.blockedText: There were too many failed confirmation attempts. If this is your link, ask the office for a new one — this one won't open any more.
first.title: Confirm it's you
first.lead: You're opening this link for the first time. So that nobody by chance — for example someone who got the text message by mistake — sees your details, enter:
first.hint: As in the submission — letter case and Polish characters don't matter. Once is enough: after that this link won't ask again.

at.long: The suffix is too long (at most 300 characters).
at.spaces: The suffix without spaces and quotes.
at.key: The link adds the person's key itself — remove “miejsce=…”.

portal.unknownAddress: I don't recognise the page address — paste it as it stands in the address bar.
portal.notAllowed: recreatio.pl/{path} can't be the page after sending this form — choose a page from the list above.
portal.shape: Address: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; separate parts with a slash.
portal.taken: Such a page already exists — choose it above.
portal.title: After sending
portal.nowhere: This form isn't on any page yet. You can prepare the portal now — just remember that once the form is placed, the portal must be the same page, a page above or below it, or another public page of the same owner.
portal.standsOn: The form is on: {pages}. Any public page of the same owner can be the portal.
portal.opensDerived: The link opens recreatio.pl/{path} — that's what the settings give, nobody chose it.
portal.how: The person gets a link to this page with their own key. The blocks “Person's submission” and “Message for the person” on this page show their details; if they aren't there, the submission appears below the page content. The key stays in their browser and also works on other pages of this organisation.
portal.astray: This page no longer fits the pages the form is on — choose another, otherwise the submission will fail.
portal.ownHint: Paste the page address (from the list above) and add after it: “#slide-name” — the link opens that slide (the name as in the slide menu, e.g. “#your-submission”), “?s=3” — the third slide, “?part=…” — a particular module. A suffix alone (“#…” or “?…”) applies to the page chosen above. The link adds the person's key itself.
portal.newHint: It will be created with this person's submission, which they can correct, and a place for a message from the office.

bar.keyless: This link is missing the key — you see the page, but not your details. Open the full link you received.
bar.gone: Your place doesn't exist — the link may have been withdrawn, replaced by a new one or expired. If you received a new link (e.g. by text message), open it.
bar.locked: The key from the link doesn't fit this place. Check that the link wasn't cut off while copying.
bar.replaced: Saved. Your link is now new — the previous one stopped working, in case it reached a wrong number. On this device you don't need to do anything; on others open the new link.

zone.submissionWho: You and the office running the sign-ups see this.
zone.noKey: Without the key from the address this can't be opened.
zone.stepsWho: You and the office see this.

link.title: Your link
link.hint: With this address you come back here — also on another device. Whoever has it sees your details, so don't pass it on.

bind.done: Done. This place is now assigned to you — you'll find it in your account, also without this link.
bind.haveAccount: Have an account? After signing in you can assign this place to yourself — then you'll reach it without the link.
bind.needPerson: To assign this place to yourself, you need a person — an account is a bunch of keys, not a human. Create one in the “Roles” tab.
bind.label: Assign to yourself — who this place is about
bind.hint: The place's key will be wrapped with this person's key. The service takes no part in this — it gets a ready envelope.

page.noPlaceText: The link may have been withdrawn or expired.
page.isKey: This link is a key, not an ID: whoever has it sees this page. Don't pass it on.
page.noKey: The address is missing the key — you can see that the place exists, but not its content. Open the full link, the one with the second part after the slash.
page.yourPage: This is your page. Over time everything will happen here: appointments and meetings, messages from the office, consent to what you share. Come back to the same address — it won't change.

verify.noToken: The address is missing the part after the slash.
verify.deadHint: Write to the office — they'll send a new one. Nothing happened: this link only confirmed the number and opened nothing else.
verify.again: This number was already confirmed — everything is fine.
verify.thanks: Thank you. The office now sees that this number works.
verify.only: This link confirmed only the phone number. It doesn't open your details, changes nothing and after use works for nobody else.
